subject: Energy
title: Hydroelectric Dams
description: Learn Hydroelectric Dams in one minute.

hook.text: Hydroelectric dams turned rivers into power plants—the first was at Niagara Falls in 1895, harnessing immense force.

buildup.text: The Hoover Dam (1936) symbolized American ambition—providing power to Los Angeles and Las Vegas from the Colorado River.

discovery.text: Hydro was the first large-scale renewable electricity—clean, reliable, and controllable with reservoir management.

twist.text: Giant dams displaced millions of people—China's Three Gorges Dam (2006) relocated 1.3 million residents.

climax.text: Hydro still provides about 16% of global electricity—the single largest source of renewable power worldwide.

punchline.text: Dammed rivers lit nations—the first clean power at scale.

quiz.question: How much of global electricity does hydropower provide?
